info.title: MegaChad Agent API
info.description: Burn-to-create looksmaxxing engine on MegaETH. Burn $MEGACHAD tokens to generate AI-enhanced portraits, mint NFTs, and earn on-chain reputation. All endpoints run on MegaETH (chain ID 4326, RPC: https://mainnet.megaeth.com/rpc).

get.summary: Get a swap quote for buying $MEGACHAD with ETH
get.description: Returns DEX swap instructions and quote from Kumbaya (Uniswap V3 fork). Without ethAmount, returns general swap info and contract addresses. With ethAmount, returns a live quote with pre-built transaction parameters.

parameters.name: ethAmount
parameters.description: Amount of ETH to swap (e.g. "0.1" or wei string). Omit for general swap info.

hasEnoughForBurn.description: Whether output covers the 225,000 burn requirement

value.description: Native ETH to send as msg.value

get.summary: Get payment and burn requirements for looksmaxxing
get.description: Returns HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements (1 USDm via Meridian) and $MEGACHAD burn requirements (225,000 tokens split between burn address and tren fund).

402.description: Payment required — contains x402 payment requirements and burn instructions

post.summary: Submit burn proof + x402 payment + image for looksmaxxing
post.description: Verifies on-chain burns, settles x402 USDm payment via Meridian, generates AI looksmaxxed portrait via Replicate, pins to IPFS, and mints NFT to the burner address.

devTxHash.description: Tx hash of 112,500 $MEGACHAD transfer to tren fund wallet

burnerAddress.description: Wallet address that sent both transfers

200.description: Looksmaxx successful — image generated, pinned, and NFT minted

400.description: Invalid input, missing fields, or burn verification failed

502.description: On-chain RPC or image generation failure

get.summary: Get $MEGACHAD token statistics
get.description: Returns total supply, circulating supply, tokens burned, and total burn count.

get.summary: Get recent looksmaxxed burns
get.description: Returns a paginated list of recent burns with IPFS image URLs.

get.summary: Get burner leaderboard with ERC-8004 reputation scores
get.description: Returns ranked list of top $MEGACHAD burners with burn counts, images, .mega names, profiles, and on-chain reputation scores from the ERC-8004 Reputation Registry.

get.summary: Get MegaChad agent registration and on-chain identity
get.description: Returns ERC-8004 registration metadata, on-chain identity details, and contract addresses.

get.summary: Get ERC-721 metadata for a looksmaxxed NFT
get.description: Returns standard ERC-721 metadata including image URL (Warren on-chain or IPFS), attributes, and storage properties.

get.summary: Get early access eligibility requirements
get.description: Returns eligibility criteria, registration instructions, and contract addresses for MegaChad testnet beta access.

200.description: Early access info and registration instructions

post.summary: Register a wallet for MegaChad testnet beta access
post.description: Verifies on-chain eligibility ($MEGACHAD balance or looksmaxxed NFTs) and registers the wallet. Returns a referral code and access status.

referralCode.description: Referral code from an existing registrant

403.description: Not eligible — wallet has no $MEGACHAD or NFTs

get.summary: Get current $MEGACHAD price from DEX
get.description: Returns the current $MEGACHAD price in ETH from the Kumbaya DEX pool, estimated burn cost, and pool info.

get.summary: Check wallet balances and burn eligibility
get.description: Returns ETH balance, $MEGACHAD balance, NFT count, burn eligibility status, and early access qualification for a wallet address.

get.summary: Get orchestrated looksmaxx flow with pre-built calldata
get.description: Returns a complete, ordered set of transaction instructions for the full looksmaxx flow (swap → burn → tren fund → submit). Each step includes pre-built calldata ready to sign and send. This is the recommended endpoint for agents.

parameters.name: ethAmount
parameters.description: ETH to swap. Omit if wallet already has enough $MEGACHAD.

get.summary: Get cross-chain bridge information for MegaETH
get.description: Returns bridge options for moving assets from Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, and other chains to MegaETH.

get.summary: Get EIP-712 typed data for a gasless burn
get.description: Returns the EIP-712 signature payload, approval status, and nonce for a gasless relay burn. Users approve the relayer contract once, then sign typed data to burn without paying gas.

200.description: Gasless burn readiness and EIP-712 typed data

ready.description: True if wallet has approval and sufficient balance

approval.description: Approval status and approve transaction if needed

signTypedData.description: EIP-712 domain, types, and message to sign

post.summary: Submit a signed gasless burn for relay
post.description: Submit an EIP-712 signed burn request. The backend relays the transaction on-chain and pays gas on behalf of the burner.

burner.description: Wallet address that signed the burn request

deadline.description: Unix timestamp after which the signature expires

400.description: Invalid signature, expired deadline, or insufficient balance/approval

get.summary: Check if a wallet is registered as a referring agent
get.description: Returns registration status, referral code, and stats for a wallet. Agents register on-chain to earn 11,250 $MEGACHAD (5% of burn) for every burn they refer.

post.summary: Register as a MegaChad referring agent
post.description: Returns transaction calldata to register on-chain as a referring agent. After registration, earn 11,250 $MEGACHAD (5% of total burn) for every burn referred via your referral code.

200.description: Registration transaction calldata and referral info

get.summary: Get referral stats and burn-with-referral calldata
get.description: Returns referral count, earnings, reward-per-burn info, and pre-built calldata for executing a referred burn. Pass ?referralCode= to resolve a code to an agent.

post.summary: Natural language interface for AI agents
post.description: Send a plain English message and get back structured, actionable responses with data and suggested next actions. Supports 17 intents: price, stats, wallet, looksmaxx, swap, gallery, leaderboard, bridge, gasless, referral, about, burn, compare, multi_burn, schedule, cross_chain_looksmaxx, register_agent.

message.example: What is the current MEGACHAD price?

200.description: Structured response with intent, answer, data, and actions

data.description: Raw data from the underlying API

get.summary: Get chat endpoint documentation
get.description: Returns supported intents, example messages, and endpoint documentation.

get.summary: Subscribe to real-time protocol events via SSE
get.description: Server-Sent Events stream emitting stats updates, new burns, and heartbeats. Auto-closes after 55s — reconnect to continue.

schema.description: SSE stream with events: connected, stats, burn, heartbeat, close

get.summary: Get the MEGA Protocol contract registry
get.description: Canonical machine-readable registry: every deployed contract (tokens, AMM, staking, governance, emissions, safety) with address, proxy/impl, key ABI functions, agent endpoints, and known gotchas (e.g. MegaChadLP tokenA/tokenB non-standard layout). Agents should fetch this once at startup and cache.

get.summary: Read combined MoggerStaking + JESTERGOONER position + APRs
get.description: Without `address`: global stats only (totalStaked, rewardRate, periodFinish, APR per venue). With `address`: also includes per-wallet position (staked, earned, allowance, NFT boost, eligibility).

get.summary: Build approve+stake / unstake / claim transaction
get.description: Returns `executionPlan: [{ to, value, data, functionName, args }]`. For stake, the plan starts with approve if allowance is insufficient (or always, if `address` is omitted).

get.summary: Quote a swap on the MEGACHAD/MEGAGOONER pair
get.description: Constant-product math (0.3% fee). Without `from`+`amount`, returns reserves + spot price. With both, returns expected output, price impact bps, and a link to the swap-tx builder. NOTE: MegaChadLP uses tokenA/tokenB rather than the V2 standard token0/token1 — generic V2 routers will not find this pool.

get.summary: Build a MEGACHAD↔MEGAGOONER swap transaction
get.description: Returns a two-step plan: ERC20.transfer(pair, amountIn) → pair.swap(amountAIn, amountBIn, to). MegaChadLP has no on-chain minOut — verify off-chain.

get.summary: Build approve+approve+addLiquidity on the MC/MG pair
List Jestermogger proposals
Get a single proposal in detail
Build castVote transaction
Build queue transaction for a Succeeded proposal
Build execute transaction for a Queued proposal
Get MEGAGOONER emission schedule + current state
get.description: 225-week quadratic decay schedule, current week, on-chain weekly emission, and the EmissionController split (mogger / jester / treasury) in bps and pct.

get.summary: Master agent index — single front door for AI agents
get.description: Returns a structured directory of every agent-facing surface MegaChad exposes: A2A/MCP/OpenAI-plugin manifests, OpenAPI spec, ERC-8004 registration, agents.txt, MCP server config, contract registry, all read + tx-builder endpoints grouped by domain, supported intents, and quickstart examples. Fetch this once at startup and cache (5 min).

get.summary: Get MEGACHADNFT count + boost tier + staking eligibility
get.description: Returns NFT balance, boost tier (1.000x/1.075x/1.150x at 1/10/25 NFTs), eligibility for staking rewards (requires 1+ NFT), next tier threshold, and recent looksmaxxed items for the wallet from the gallery cache.

get.summary: Get CircuitBreaker pause state + NFTVetoCouncil composition
get.description: Snapshot of safety surfaces agents should check before issuing writes. Includes CircuitBreaker (paused, pausedAt, autoUnpauseTime, guardians, pause/unpause votes) and NFTVetoCouncil (council size, veto threshold, veto window, current members, seats filled).

get.summary: Unified recent on-chain activity feed across the MEGA Protocol stack
get.description: Parallel getLogs across Token transfers (burns to dEaD), staking (stake/unstake/claim) on both venues, Framemogger MegachadSent events, and Jestermogger governance (ProposalCreated/VoteCast/Queued/Executed). Normalized to { kind, blockNumber, txHash, summary, actor, amount, ... } sorted newest-first.

parameters.name: blocks
parameters.description: Block lookback window (default ≈ 8 min on MegaETH)

get.summary: Check Framemogger top-3 burner eligibility to propose
get.description: Returns canPropose verdict + currentWeek + getWeekTop3 burners for the proposer (or current connected agent). Only the week's top 3 burners can call Jestermogger.propose().

post.description: Validates target/value/calldata arrays and encodes propose(targets[], values[], calldatas[], description). Lifecycle: 1d delay → 3d voting → 2d timelock → 7d grace.

400.description: Validation failure (array length / address / wei / calldata)

get.summary: Build NFTVetoCouncil veto transaction(s)
get.description: If no veto window is currently open, prepends startVetoVote(id) so a council member can both kick off the window and cast in one bundle. Always appends castVetoVote(id, support). support: yes/veto = true, no/against = false. 20 seats, 11-veto threshold, 2-day window.

parameters.name: voter
parameters.description: Voter address to check council membership + prior vote

ContractAddresses.description: Key contract addresses on MegaETH (chain ID 4326)
